description: Everything the Analyse-Agent needs for the nightly analysis in one JSON: schaetzen = completed orders of the last days not yet estimated (auftrag_typ, auftrag_id, tag, agent, ablauf, kanal, ergebnis, umfang, werkzeugschritte, measured AI cost in CHF; von_hand {grund, belege} when a human did the work himself — then ergebnis is gescheitert and there is no saving), anchors (latest human reference values and corrections per workflow), implemented optimisations without a software-level estimate, the tenant's rates, the estimation rules; berichte = the reports due today (daily; weekly on Monday; monthly on the 1st; yearly on 1 January) with all numbers and evidence (zahlen), the previous period, a deterministic template text (vorlage_md, vorlage_kurzfassung) and whether one is already stored; regeln_bericht. Optional: nur_berichte (skip the estimation part — call again after record_ersparnis), arten (subset), von/bis (custom period instead), ebene (alle|agenten|software). Admins, planners and agents. Read-only.

nur_berichte.description: true skips the estimation part and returns only the reports

name: get_analysepaket
